Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ayaan - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Kunal - 8 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Sunita and Kunal stand near him.]

Kunal: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan stands up.]

Ayaan: "What a day to remember!"
